rungs.title: Paid bounties
rungs.proof: Time to finish a discrete task and build public proof of work.

programs.name: Superteam Earn
programs.amount: Stablecoin bounties; prize pools vary by listing
programs.terms: Competitive: selected submissions win, finishing does not guarantee a payout. Keep 100% of your company.

rungs.title: Instagrants
rungs.proof: A repo, demo or past bounty wins, plus one milestone you can ship.
rungs.notice: “Applications Paused” on the listing as of 15 Nov 2026. Check with @SuperteamUKR before applying.

programs.name: Solana Foundation Ukraine Grants
programs.terms: For people in Ukraine. Confirm rights in the grant agreement. 25% upfront, the rest against milestones. Average initial response around one week.

programs.name: Solana Mobile Builder Grants
programs.terms: Milestone funding for mobile builders; may include co-marketing and launch support.

rungs.title: Foundation grants
rungs.proof: An open-source Solana public good and a clear plan for the funds.

programs.name: Solana Foundation
programs.terms: Milestone grants, convertible grants and RFPs. First review about one week, decision about three weeks. Commercial projects may need a convertible grant.

rungs.title: Hackathons
rungs.proof: A working product and a pitch video.

programs.name: Colosseum Frontier
programs.terms: Past Solana hackathon. Winners can interview for Colosseum’s accelerator.

programs.name: Colosseum Eternal
programs.terms: Four-week sprint with weekly updates. The Eternal Award is for startups that have not raised venture capital.

programs.name: Superteam Ukraine
programs.amount: Up to $10,000 in local track prizes
programs.terms: Free Solana Startup Terminal course for teams preparing for Colosseum; check the current intake.

rungs.title: Accelerators
rungs.proof: A hackathon win or strong early traction, depending on the programme.

programs.name: Colosseum Accelerator
programs.terms: SAFE and token warrant, or STAMP for teams tokenizing through MetaDAO. Includes in-person attendance. Enter through a hackathon win or Eternal.

programs.name: Alliance
programs.amount: $400,000 on admission, plus $400,000 follow-on at seed
programs.terms: $4M post-money valuation at admission, on a SAFE with a 1:1 token side letter.

programs.name: Solana Incubator
programs.terms: Build alongside Solana Labs in New York, with technical and fundraising support and a relocation stipend.

rungs.title: Venture rounds
rungs.proof: Users or revenue an investor can verify in a data room.

programs.name: Solana venture investors
programs.terms: Instruments vary by deal; check each announcement. Expect to discuss both equity and token rights.

rungs.title: On-chain raises
rungs.proof: A live product and a community that already wants the token.

programs.name: MetaDAO launches
programs.amount: Founder sets the minimum and cap. Umbra raised $3M (per its MetaDAO page).
programs.terms: Buyers have four days to commit USDC. Accepted funds enter a market-governed treasury. Founder spending and token unlocks follow the sale rules.
